data.name: Akilah
data.gender_notes: Akilah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'akl', meaning 'intellect' or 'intelligence'. The name Akilah signifies a woman of great wisdom and intelligence. The name Akilah carries the meaning “Intelligent, Wise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Akilah usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner wisdom and intelligence that guides one's life and decisions.
data.etymology: Akilah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intelligent, Wise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Akilah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: عقيلة
in_arabic.meaning: عقيلة تعني الذكية و العاقلة و الحكيمة جدا
in_arabic.long_meaning: عقيلة هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي و يعني الذكية و العاقلة و الحكيمة جدا، و هو مشتق من الفعل عقّل و عقل. و في اللغة العربية، العقل هو ضد الجهل و هو اسم يدل على التفكير و التمييز. و قد ورد هذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم في سورة النمل آية ١٢ حيث قال تعالى: 'وَلَقَدْ أَعْطَيْنَا مُوسَى وَهَارُونَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ وَالذِكْرِ وَالْحِكْمَةِ وَالْعِلْمِ الْقَضِيِّ وَمَا كُنتُمَا إِذًا لِلرَّقِيبِ تَكْفُرانِ'

in_urdu.name: عقیلہ
in_urdu.meaning: عقیلہ ذہین، عقلمند، دانا، و ہوشیار
in_urdu.long_meaning: عقیلہ ایک علم نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے ذہین، عقلمند، دانا، و ہوشیار۔ یہ نام اسلامی دنیا میں بہت مقبول ہے کیونکہ یہ علم و حکمت کی علامت ہے۔ عربی زبان میں 'عَقَلَ' کا مطلب ہے سمجھنا یا عقلمند ہونا۔ یہ نام خاص طور پر ان کی لڑکیوں کے لئے منتخب کیا جاتا ہے جو ذہین اور عقلمند ہوں۔

in_hindi.name: अक़ीलाह
in_hindi.long_meaning: अक़ीलाह एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है जो इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से आया है और इसका अर्थ है बुद्धिमान, समझदार, और ज्ञानवान। यह नाम उन लड़कियों के लिए चुना जाता है जो बुद्धिमान और समझदार होती हैं। इस्लामी संस्कृति में, अक़ीलाह नाम का चयन करना माता-पिता की इच्छा होती है कि उनकी बेटी बुद्धिमान और समझदार बने।

in_pashto.name: عاقله
in_pashto.long_meaning: عاقله د ښځينو یو نوم دی چې د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دا نوم د پوهېدونکې، عقلمند، او دانا معنی لري. په پښتو کلتور کې، دا نوم د هغو نجونو لپاره کارول کیږي چې پوهېدونکې او عقلمندې وي.

in_english.name: Akilah
in_english.meaning: Akilah means intelligent, wise, and discerning
in_english.long_meaning: Akilah is a beautiful and meaningful name that originates from Arabic. It means intelligent, wise, and discerning. The name Akilah is derived from the Arabic root 'aqala', which means to understand or to be intelligent. In Islamic tradition, Akilah is a popular name for girls because it symbolizes wisdom, intelligence, and discernment. The name Akilah is mentioned in the Quran in Surah An-Naml verse 12, where Allah says, 'And indeed We gave to Moses and Aaron knowledge and remembrance and wisdom.'

This ties in with many Islamic values and cultural traditions that place a high value on education and knowledge. In many Islamic societies and communities, the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom is seen as a lifelong endeavor and a crucial aspect of personal growth and development. Therefore, the name Akilah reflects an appreciation for these cultural values and the immense importance placed upon intelligence and knowledge.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Akilah can be seen as a reminder of the importance of using one's intelligence and wisdom to benefit not only oneself, but also others. In Islamic teachings, the use of one's intellect and knowledge for the betterment of society and the world is highly encouraged. The name Akilah can also be seen as a symbol of a deep and thoughtful connection to the divine, as intelligence and wisdom are often considered to be God-given gifts that should be used to connect with and understand the spiritual realm. Ultimately, the name Akilah embodies the idea of a woman who is not only intelligent and wise, but also uses her gifts to make a positive impact on the world around her.
